**Result: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

- **Basis:** § 12.3 (p0044) both negatively and affirmatively protects us: nothing restricts us from "engaging any supplier," and Vendor acknowledges we made "no exclusivity … commitment." That satisfies the sole preferred element outright, so there is nothing to narrow to the fallback.
- **Adjacent burdens deliberately not flagged here:** § 7.2's disclose-and-match gate (MFN/right-to-match rule), § 2.1's take-or-pay floor (minimum-commitment rule), and the duplicate § 12.4 competition restraint (non-compete rule). Flagging any of them under EXCLUSIVITY would double-count the same commercial term.
- **Clauses reviewed and cleared as non-responsive or Customer-favourable:** § 13.1 non-exclusive licence to us, § 19.4 / § 21.4 / § 30.2 exclusive-remedy wording, § 28.1–28.2 exclusive jurisdiction, § 14.2 Vendor ownership, and § 27.3 (which expressly lets us procure substitute services).
